interface: HID usage page 0xFF02, report ID 0, 32-byte payload
source: Vendor CBMouse app writes (debugger-captured) and passive read-only HID listening, receiver 0x089D:0x062F and cable 0x088D:0x062E. No serials or personal data.

frames.name: identify-request
frames.note: Vendor app write, 32-byte payload after report ID 0.

frames.name: identify-reply-battery
frames.note: Receiver, on battery. data[8]=0, data[9]=0x3e (62 percent).

frames.name: identify-reply-cable
frames.note: USB cable, charging. data[8]=1, data[9]=0x64 is a fixed 100.

frames.name: dpi-write
frames.note: Command 0x03, same table as the read reply with an offset byte in front.

frames.name: button-map-read-reply-factory
frames.note: Factory map read after reset: 6 slots x 3 bytes (Left, Right, Middle, Back, Forward, DPI).

frames.name: button-write-back-to-slot-4
frames.note: Command 0x01, vendor app write: slot 4 (Forward) set to Back (20 08 00). The device echoes the frame.

frames.name: button-write-volume-up-to-slot-1
frames.note: Command 0x01, vendor app write: slot 1 (Right) set to Volume up (90 e9 00). The device echoes the frame.

frames.name: asleep-echo
frames.note: Status 2: the mouse is asleep and the receiver echoes the request; retry later.

frames.name: link-event
frames.note: Unsolicited command 0xd1; ignored by the driver.
